newsitem.title: USA: SunRiver names chairman, acting pres/CEO.
newsitem.headline: SunRiver names chairman, acting pres/CEO.

text.p: SunRiver Corp said Thursday it had named Leonard Mackenzie as chairman and acting president and chief executive.

Mackenzie replaces Gerald Youngblood, who resigned as chairman and chief executive about a week after the company's majority stockholder, SunRiver Group Inc, sought his departure and several other management changes.
Besides asking for Youngblood's resignation, SunRiver Group sought an increase in the size of the board to seven members and the election of three of its designees to the board.
SunRiver said Thursday that Sam Smith, Ron Brittian and John Osborne had resigned from the board.
Osborne also resigned as president and chief executive of the company's subsidiary, Boundless Technologies Inc.
Roger Hughes has resigned as chief financial officer of SunRiver.
Most recently, Mackenzie was a director and board member of General Automation Inc.
